coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: Exclude donations, resource lists, regular schedules, holiday/routine closures, older groceries/pantries, ongoing financial distress without closure, historical SNAP disruptions, duplicate news and generic economic stories.
coverage_notes.assessment: Twelve bounded targeted searches plus six successful direct page checks found no new qualifying in-window U.S. disruption. Two failed page requests warrant DEGRADED per watch policy but had no material effect on useful coverage. Local reporting and indexing lag prevent exhaustive nationwide completeness.
